mode: read-only semantic review against saved source extraction; no providers or demo writes

findings.issue: Effortless power with hybrid efficiency adds driving-feel and efficiency claims beyond its assigned specifications.
findings.source_evidence: Page 12 explicitly says the fuel-consumption field is a placeholder and no consumption figure is quoted. The assigned facts state the engine, power and torque.
findings.recommended_action: Replace the USP through normal Align/playbook review with a supported descriptive choice; no effortless/efficiency claim. Do not copy this wording into Author or Deck.

findings.issue: All-wheel drive alone does not establish passenger isolation from harsh roads.
findings.source_evidence: F005 states xDrive all-wheel drive. Page 11 describes two-axle air suspension separately, but that detail is absent from the extracted registry.
findings.recommended_action: Limit this stop to its assigned supported drivetrain detail, or add the separately cited suspension fact through the normal reviewed-fact path. Attribute source performance descriptions; do not infer ride comfort from AWD.

findings.issue: Package duration is marked as answering service/maintenance cost; no cost is provided.
findings.source_evidence: Page 18 lists Service Inclusive Basic 3 years or 40,000 km and says service-package charges included in the EMI calculation are paid by the customer.
findings.recommended_action: Mark actual cost unknown; describe a listed package only, with price/package terms to confirm. Never call it free, automatically included, or a service-cost quote.

findings.issue: Standard audio equipment is an added availability assertion.
findings.source_evidence: Page 9 lists Harman Kardon surround sound system, 16 speakers, 464 W output; it does not label this standard equipment. Page 32 warns illustrated equipment/configurations may differ in India.
findings.recommended_action: Remove unsupported standard qualification; retain the source-listed audio description and verify selected vehicle configuration where relevant.

findings.issue: Automatic parking description omits the performed-once manoeuvre prerequisite and nearby supervision in its value/conditions.
findings.source_evidence: Page 14: perform the manoeuvre once, up to 200 metres; the car parks/leaves on request while you monitor everything close by on your smartphone.
findings.recommended_action: Carry the performed-once prerequisite and nearby monitoring into the fact conditions and any substantive claim. Do not imply fully autonomous, unsupervised parking.

findings.issue: Value and conditions omit compatible devices, inviting universal smartphone/smartwatch support.
findings.source_evidence: Page 14 begins: Compatible mobile devices become your BMW Digital Key.
findings.recommended_action: Retain compatible-device restriction in the fact and same spoken thought. Existing quote already contains it; it is not new evidence.

findings.issue: Offer-specific facts do not carry all material charges, availability and approval conditions; F087 is separate and outside the Coach ownership stop facts.
findings.source_evidence: Page 18: limited units/some states, taxes extra, change without notice, service-package and registration charges paid by customer; finance approval at BMW India Financial Services discretion. Page 32 restates the general offer caveat.
findings.recommended_action: Either omit expiring numerical offer promises from the main tour or cite and state the material scope/conditions with the offer. Do not promise the quoted EMI or benefits to this visitor.

findings.issue: Service package fact does not say it is a separately charged offer package.
findings.source_evidence: Page 18: Registration charges and the service-package charges included in the EMI calculation are paid by the customer.
findings.recommended_action: Preserve offer/package context and charges; keep it separate from standard warranty. Do not claim standard inclusion or that it pays all service costs.

findings.issue: Up to 40% lower has no explicit comparator in the extracted table, and buyback value depends on chosen finance terms.
findings.source_evidence: Page 20 is a finance-plan comparison; page 18 says assured buyback percentages depend on tenure, mileage and manufacturing year.
findings.recommended_action: Do not generalize 40% lower into a customer saving or compare against an invented baseline. Keep buyback conditions with the finance-plan claim.

findings.issue: Extended warranty omits new-car-only eligibility, cost-option status and earliest time/kilometre limit despite retaining purchase timing.
findings.source_evidence: Page 24: sold on a cost-option basis and only to new cars; ends at whichever comes first, kilometre limit or time limit of chosen package; covers original factory-built specification with listed exclusions.
findings.recommended_action: Carry optional paid new-car scope and time/kilometre limit into any up-to-ten-years statement. Do not call this included or unlimited-mileage extended protection; preserve exclusions in deeper detail.

findings.issue: Adjacent source pages state different start-event lists; do not turn the narrower page-24 summary into the definitive event rule.
findings.source_evidence: Page 24 says registration or invoice, whichever sooner; page 25 policy says first drive, official registration, invoice or possession, whichever comes first.
findings.recommended_action: Prefer the detailed policy scope for contract explanation, preserve source distinction and avoid pretending the summaries are identical. General 24-month/no-mileage-limit duration remains supported.

findings.issue: The new extraction retains named exclusions, but the rust effective_from invents an exact date and fuller claim conditions are absent.
findings.source_evidence: Page 25 says vehicles sold after 2010, not 2010-01-01. Rust claims exclude specified parts and require specified maintenance/repair/inspection conditions; paint and wearing-part exclusions are explicit.
findings.recommended_action: Remove fabricated exact effective date or retain only the source year wording. Keep exclusions in any warranty-specific answer; add the detailed rust claim conditions if that topic is narrated rather than giving unconditional coverage.

findings.issue: Roof box is an accessory, but optional/accessory status and unlisted price are absent from fact scope.
findings.source_evidence: Page 28 is Genuine accessories for the X7; prices are not published and readers should contact a BMW Sales Consultant.
findings.recommended_action: Label as optional/accessory detail; never add its 520 litres to the vehicle luggage capacity or imply it is included.

findings.issue: Image-file pixel dimensions are extraction metadata, not useful customer product facts.
findings.source_evidence: Page 31 is the image library index with file names, dimensions and source locations.
findings.recommended_action: Exclude these rows from customer-facing product narration and selling points; they should not satisfy supported narration length.

findings.issue: Only one of three selected USPs belongs to a fundamental stop, contrary to the existing two-fundamental rule.
findings.source_evidence: playbook.issues explicitly records At least two supported USPs must sit on fundamental stops; usp_seats and usp_climate both point to cabin.
findings.recommended_action: Review and correct the selected USPs through existing Align/playbook mechanism before publication; no new rule needed.

findings.issue: The source itself warns illustrations may not match the Indian vehicle; some parking/boat pictures show a different model, and exterior images cannot show an internal engine.
findings.source_evidence: Page 32 equipment/configuration warning; page 14 parking illustrations include a white vehicle/boat rather than the X7. Existing vision descriptions identify exterior views separately from cabin/detail pictures.
findings.recommended_action: Use matching actual X7 pictures and reviewed anchors. Mark legitimate mechanism illustrations clearly; never claim a nonvisible engine, drivetrain or safety system is physically shown.

positive_findings: Category is Luxury SUV and selects premium SUV library.
Paint/rust/accessory warranty exclusions omitted in the original demo are now retained in fact conditions.
Engine, motor and total-system torque are separate facts.
Owner-selected two-minute duration is not changed by this review.
limits: This review does not mutate approvals or scripts. Root must apply any corrections through existing review paths.
Quoted source compilation is treated as owner-uploaded evidence; no independent current BMW-web verification was performed.
Human script and visual review remains needed after Author/Deck complete.
